fact: IT expert Jean Luce Randriamihoatra was sentenced to three years in prison in February 2025, having been prosecuted among other charges for intrusion into an information system and importing and modifying computer data in the Ceni website case (the report cites opposition supporters for the sentence; the law is not named).
title: PIRATAGE DU SITE DE LA CENI - Jean Luce Randriamihoatra condamné
